settings.title: Apaczka
settings.description: Connection and configuration of the Apaczka.pl integration.
settings.disabledHint: The plugin is inactive because its options are missing or invalid. Set them in medusa-config.ts (usually APACZKA_APP_ID and APACZKA_APP_SECRET) and restart Medusa.
settings.authError: Apaczka rejected the credentials. Check appId and appSecret (Apaczka panel → Settings → API).
settings.configHint: These values come from the plugin options in medusa-config.ts.
settings.webhookMissing: Not set. Set webhooks.backendUrl in the plugin options, or paste your backend URL + /hooks/apaczka/tracking into the Apaczka panel (Settings → WebAPI).
settings.servicesHint: Pick these when creating a shipping option with the Apaczka provider.

list.search: Search by waybill, Apaczka or order number
list.empty: No Apaczka shipments yet. They appear here when you fulfill orders with an Apaczka shipping option.
list.mixedPickup: One courier pickup needs shipments with the same service and sender; select matching ones.

weight.title: Parcel weight
weight.hint: How parcels are weighed when products have no weight.
weight.defaults: A product without a weight counts as {{weight}} kg per unit (option parcel.defaultItemWeightKg). Catalog weights are read in {{unit}}; packaging adds {{packaging}} kg; a parcel weighs at least {{min}} kg.
weight.hold: Hold shipments with products without a weight
weight.holdHint: On: such a shipment is not created automatically. It waits on the order with the reason, so someone can enter the real weight and create it. Off: it is sent with the default weight.
weight.holdManualMode: Shipments are created by hand anyway (shipmentCreation: manual); the warning shows in the shipment form.
weight.missingHint: Enter their weight in the product (variant → Shipping). Until then, parcels use the default weight.
weight.warningTitle_one: {{count}} product has no weight: it counts as {{weight}} kg per unit.
weight.warningTitle_other: {{count}} products have no weight: each counts as {{weight}} kg per unit.
weight.warningHint: Check the parcel weight below before creating the shipment; a wrong weight can mean a carrier surcharge.
weight.held: Waiting: a product has no weight. Check the parcel weight and create the shipment.
